semiconductor_relevance: High — Bühler Alzenau GmbH specializes in thin film deposition technology critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Bühler Alzenau GmbH, through its Bühler Leybold Optics division, provides advanced thin film deposition equipment essential for producing high-precision coatings on semiconductor components. Their HELIOS platform is optimized for applications in CMOS and ADAS sensors, ensuring high reliability and process stability in semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Magnetron Sputtering equipment for optical and functional coatings
Batch and inline coating machines for precision optics
